results.title: Like many women, single mum Amy explained away her niggling hip pain. Then she was diagnosed with incurable cancer at just 47 years old
results.description: Amy Loftus went to the doctor for 'cosmetic' reasons - she never expected a devastating diagnosis to follow.

results.title: NEET PG 2026 application correction window opens at natboard.edu.in, edit forms till July 28: Direct link here
results.description: The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences has opened the NEET PG 2026 application correction window. Candidates can edit most details on their application forms until July 28, 2026. A selective edit window for uploaded images will be available from July 31. The NEET PG 2026 examination is scheduled for August 30, 2026. Applicants must verify all details carefully before the deadline.
